title: CRM Manager
description:
Headquarters: Denmark; Finland; Latvia; Lithuania; Netherlands; Remote; Spain; Tallinn, Harju, Estonia
URL: http://bondora.group

At Bondora, our mission is simple: to make finance easy, transparent, and accessible for everyone.

Founded in 2008, we’ve helped more than 700,000 customers across Europe borrow and invest effortlessly through our trusted digital products.

As a rapidly growing financial technology company, we’re reaching new heights with a bold vision. We’re set to acquire a banking license, unlocking a world of possibilities for our customers. This transition will allow us to expand our lending across more EU countries and broaden our product suite to deliver even more value.

Join us on this journey and let’s build the future of finance together!

What is this role about? 🚀

As a CRM Manager, you build and run the customer journeys that guide Bondora’s customers through their whole lifecycle: from their first loan application and onboarding, to repeat loans and add-ons, to the moments when repayments get difficult. You’ll be one of three CRM Managers in Bondora’s CRM & Customer Value team, reporting to the Head of CRM & Customer Value. Our CRM runs on Braze, with unusually rich customer and loan data and value signals already flowing in. You’ll decide what to build by its value in loans and euros, prove what works against holdout groups, and treat every customer fairly: a loan is a financial decision, not a shopping cart.

Your main responsibilities 🎯

  • Build and run customer journeys in Braze across the lifecycle: application and onboarding, repeat loans and add-ons, reactivation, and payment difficulty, with QA before every launch and zero customer-facing errors.
  • Design journeys around the customer’s situation: triggers, timing, cadence, channels and fallback, stop rules, and handovers to self-service, a human or another journey.
  • Prove what works: build a control or holdout into every journey and report results as business outcomes (signed loans, revenue, arrears), not opens or clicks.
  • Prioritise by value: size opportunities in loans and euros before building, and rank your work by value rather than volume.
  • Own compliance and risk suppression: classify messages correctly, respect consent, never send commercial messages to customers showing payment risk, and involve Legal and Risk before launch.
  • Keep the data reliable: validate events and attributes, fix journeys that act on wrong or late data, and escalate upstream issues with evidence.
  • Move legacy communications into Braze and work through the team’s shared rules: one intake route for requests, and clean handovers with the other CRM Managers.

What would ensure success in this role?💪

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in CRM or lifecycle marketing. Experience in lending, fintech or recurring-revenue businesses is a plus.
  • Hands-on production experience in Braze or a comparable platform (Iterable, Customer.io, Salesforce Marketing Cloud): journeys, segmentation, event and API triggers, dynamic content and QA. You build it yourself, not through an agency.
  • Experience designing journeys for different lifecycle stages, built around the customer’s situation rather than a fixed sequence.
  • Experimentation literacy: you design tests with holdouts, read business outcomes rather than open rates, and can pull your own data (SQL or a product analytics tool).
  • Commercial judgment: you can estimate what an improvement is worth in loans and euros and decide what to build first.
  • Sound compliance judgment: transactional vs. promotional messages, consent, and responsible treatment of customers in a credit business.
  • A habit of checking data before trusting it, and of fixing problems at the root.
  • Working expertise in email, SMS and WhatsApp, with modular, localisable content for several markets.
  • A habit of using AI to speed up QA and analysis, with the judgment to know when not to trust it.
  • High ownership and a bias to action: you’d rather ship something good this week than something perfect next quarter, and you drive conversations with Product, Engineering, Legal and Risk toward decisions.

What can you expect at Bondora? 

  • Contribute to Bondora’s ambitious goal of reaching 1BN in revenue. Your skills and efforts will directly impact our growth trajectory and shape the future of our company.
  • Our employees deserve the best. We recognize our people with a competitive salary and a generous benefits package (5 weeks of vacation, private healthcare compensation, hobby grant, mental healthcare support, share options and much more!)
  • We provide an environment that encourages your personal and professional growth. As we constantly evolve and innovate, you’ll have endless opportunities (and budget) to expand your skills and skyrocket your career.

The next steps

If you have the guts, ideas, and a team vision, apply now! 

Our hiring process: 

1️⃣ Meet Anna, our Recruiter — your first chat to share your story and ambitions.
2️⃣ Meet Mario, CMO. 
3️⃣ Tackle a home task to showcase your skills.
4️⃣ Complete our personality and logic assessments via Alva Labs.
5️⃣ Meet Pärtel Tomberg, our CEO.
6️⃣ Bar Raiser interview with Olga Kikas, our Chief of People.
7️⃣ 🎉 If the stars align — welcome to Bondora!

 

Join our team of Bondorians, and let's make it happen!

If you'd like to read how Bondora collects, uses, and protects your personal data during recruitment, please see HERE.

title: Global CRM & Lifecycle Marketing Manager
description:
Headquarters: Malta
URL: http://fpmarkets.com.au

Description

FP Markets Group of Companies is a well-established multi-regulated broker, founded in Australia, offering traders access to CFD trading on Forex, Indices, Commodities, Stocks and Cryptocurrencies. We are growing and looking to recruit a Full-time Global CRM & Lifecycle Marketing Manager (remote).

This role owns everything we say to a client between the moment they first raise their hand and the moment they place their first trade. You will design, build, send and continuously improve every automated and campaign communication across four funnel stages — Lead, Registration, First Time Deposit and First Time Trade — using email and WhatsApp, built and run in Salesforce Marketing Cloud. This is a hands-on build-and-send role rather than a strategy role: you will have the support of content, creative and analytics teams, but the journeys are yours to build, and each stage carries a conversion rate that is yours to move.

Reporting to: Chief Marketing Officer

Responsibilities:

Journey design & automation — Salesforce Marketing Cloud

  • Own the design, build and optimisation of automated journeys across all four funnel stages
  • Manage audience, segmentation, entry and suppression logic
  • Rationalise existing automations and maintain a documented, auditable journey estate

Email execution

  • Build, QA and deploy automated and campaign email communications
  • Own templates and modular content to enable scalable regional localisation
  • Manage deliverability, consent, preferences and list hygiene

WhatsApp execution

  • Own WhatsApp marketing end to end, from opt-in and template approval to sequencing and frequency management
  • Use data to determine channel allocation and optimise engagement
  • Manage channel costs, forecasting and provider relationships

Optimisation & measurement

  • Lead continuous testing across messaging, timing, channels, sequencing and offers
  • Partner with Analytics to measure performance through to funded account and first trade
  • Report on funnel conversion and explain key performance movements

Compliance

  • Embed jurisdictional and regulatory requirements into journey design
  • Partner with Compliance on efficient approvals and maintain a clear communications audit trail

Candidate profile:

  • Proven hands-on experience building multi-step nurture journeys and automated flows in Salesforce Marketing Cloud. You must be able to demonstrate what you have personally built; applications without clear hands-on SFMC experience cannot be progressed
  • Strong practical experience with Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Email Studio, Content Builder, Data Extensions and SQL for segmentation. AMPscript is an advantage; for Marketing Cloud Next, experience with Data Cloud, identity resolution and Flow is relevant
  • Demonstrable experience running WhatsApp as a marketing channel, including opt-ins, template approvals and the 24-hour service window. Email-only experience is not sufficient
  • Experience owning conversion performance, with clear examples of baseline results, changes made and measurable outcomes
  • Solid knowledge of email deliverability, consent and data-protection requirements across multiple jurisdictions
  • Comfortable writing automated-message copy and briefing creative where needed
  • Fluent English, written and spoken

Our offer:

  • Welcoming, young and multicultural team with approachable leadership
  • Ability to contribute to dynamic business at a growth phase
  • High level of autonomy, support of ideas and putting your expertise into the best practices for the company
  • Continuous personal development, training budget, growth with the company and opportunity to learn from industry leaders
  • Competitive remuneration, regular salary reviews and performance-based incentive schemes
  • Vibrant company life: from team activities to global celebrations

Journey to FP Markets:

  • Interview with HR (30 - 45 min)
  • Interview with your future manager (1h)

Join our team and be a part of a professional, rapidly-growing company operating in a multicultural environment!

title: Lead Intake / CRM Manager
description:
Headquarters: Beirut, Lebanon
URL: http://jobsforhumanity.com

Company Description

AB Group PLLC is a dynamic architecture firm with a passion for delivering innovative and impactful designs. Specializing in hospitality, multifamily, and office projects, we take pride in creating spaces that inspire. We are expanding our talented team and looking for a skilled Autodesk Revit Draftsperson to join us remotely from Lebanon.

Job Description

Position Overview

ABG is seeking a highly responsive, articulate, and results-driven Appointment Setter and HubSpot CRM Manager.
This person will be responsible for contacting new inbound leads within 60 seconds of:

  • Submitting a contact form through the ABG website.
  • Calling ABG’s front desk line.
  • Leaving a voicemail or missed call.
  • Entering ABG’s lead system through another marketing channel.
  • This position requires an exceptionally high sense of urgency. Every minute of delay reduces the likelihood of connecting with and converting a prospective client.
  • The successful candidate must have impeccable spoken and written English, a confident telephone presence, strong listening skills, and the ability to communicate professionally with business owners, developers, contractors, investors, property owners, and other decision-makers.
  • The role also includes cold calling and cold emailing targeted contact lists to create new relationships and generate opportunities in specific geographic and industry markets.

Core Responsibilities

Inbound Lead Response

  • Monitor website inquiries, phone calls, voicemails, emails, and assigned lead notifications throughout working hours.
  • Call every new website lead within 60 seconds of form submission.
  • Return every missed front desk call within 60 seconds of receiving the notification.
  • Answer live calls promptly and professionally whenever assigned to front desk coverage.
  • Send an immediate follow-up email when a lead does not answer.
  • Continue following up through an organized call and email cadence until the lead:
  • Responds.
  • Schedules an appointment.
  • Requests future follow-up.
  • Is confirmed as unqualified.
  • Opts out of further communication.
  • Never allow an inbound lead to sit in HubSpot without a documented response attempt and scheduled next action.

Lead Qualification

  • Conduct an effective initial conversation to understand:
  • Prospect name, company, and contact information.
  • Project address and geographic location.
  • Project type and intended use.
  • Requested architectural, engineering, interior design, permitting, or consulting services.
  • Current project status.
  • Estimated project size and scope.
  • Target schedule.
  • Preliminary construction or design budget.
  • Property ownership or site-control status.
  • Decision-makers involved.
  • How the prospect heard about ABG.
  • Identify whether the opportunity is aligned with ABG’s services and target markets.
  • Ask clear and direct questions without making the prospect feel interrogated.
  • Avoid providing technical, legal, pricing, or code-related advice beyond the approved qualification script.
  • Escalate urgent, high-value, or strategically important opportunities immediately.
  • Appointment Setting
  • Schedule qualified prospects with the correct ABG team member.
  • Confirm the appointment date, time, meeting format, project address, and attendee information.
  • Send calendar invitations and confirmation messages immediately.
  • Send appointment reminders to improve attendance.
  • Reschedule cancelled or missed appointments quickly.
  • Ensure the assigned ABG team member has complete qualification notes before the meeting.
  • Follow up after the appointment when directed and update the opportunity status in HubSpot.

HubSpot CRM Management

  • Serve as the day-to-day owner of sales data quality in HubSpot.
  • Create and maintain accurate:
  • Contact records.
  • Company records.
  • Deal records.
  • Lead-source information.
  • Deal stages.
  • Activity records.
  • Follow-up tasks.
  • Appointment records.
  • Log every call, voicemail, email, response, qualification note, appointment, and follow-up action.
  • Ensure every open lead has:
  • A clearly assigned owner.
  • The correct pipeline stage.
  • Complete contact information.
  • A documented last activity.
  • A scheduled next action.
  • A realistic follow-up date.
  • Move deals through ABG’s sales pipeline based on verified activity:
  • First Contact.
  • Discovery.
  • Send Fee.
  • Fee Sent.
  • Standby.
  • Accepted.
  • Send Contract.
  • Contract Sent.
  • Project Won or Project Lost.
  • Prevent duplicate contacts, companies, and deals.
  • Standardize naming conventions and correct incomplete or inaccurate records.
  • Identify stale deals, overdue tasks, missing follow-ups, and opportunities without recent activity.
  • Maintain lead lists, call queues, workflows, templates, sequences, and reporting dashboards.
  • Produce daily and weekly reports covering:
  • New inbound leads.
  • Average response time.
  • Leads contacted within 60 seconds.
  • Contact rate.
  • Qualified leads.
  • Appointments scheduled.
  • Appointment attendance rate.
  • Outbound calls and emails.
  • New relationships created.
  • Pipeline-stage movement.
  • Stale or neglected opportunities.
  • CRM data-quality issues.
  • Cold Calling and Cold Emailing

Conduct structured outbound campaigns targeting ABG’s priority markets.

  • Call and email prospective:
  • Real estate developers.
  • General contractors.
  • Commercial property owners.
  • Real estate investors.
  • Brokers and tenant representatives.
  • Property managers.
  • Franchise owners and operators.
  • Restaurant and hospitality groups.
  • Retail and industrial businesses.
  • Multifamily and residential developers.
  • Strategic referral partners.
  • Research contacts and verify names, titles, companies, telephone numbers, email addresses, locations, and market relevance.
  • Use approved scripts and email templates while keeping conversations natural and personalized.
  • Introduce ABG’s capabilities clearly and confidently.
  • Focus on building relationships, identifying upcoming projects, and securing introductory meetings.
  • Handle common objections professionally and continue the conversation without becoming aggressive.
  • Document all outbound activity and prospect responses in HubSpot.
  • Create follow-up tasks for every viable prospect.
  • Maintain organized prospect lists by market, relationship type, campaign, and opportunity status.
  • Provide feedback on which industries, messages, and contact lists generate the strongest results.

Non-Negotiable Performance Standards

  • Demonstrate an exceptional sense of urgency at all times.
  • Contact new inbound leads within 60 seconds during assigned coverage hours.
  • Maintain impeccable spoken and written English.
  • Communicate clearly without grammatical errors, excessive filler words, slang, or an unprofessional tone.
  • Remain available and attentive during scheduled lead-response coverage.
  • Treat every inbound inquiry as a time-sensitive potential client.
  • Complete CRM updates immediately after each interaction.
  • Never rely on memory or personal notes in place of HubSpot documentation.
  • Never leave a lead without a clearly documented next action.
  • Follow through on commitments without repeated reminders.
  • Maintain a polished, confident, helpful, and professional demeanor.
  • Protect confidential client, project, and company information.
  • Key Performance Indicators

Percentage of inbound leads called within 60 seconds.

  • Average first-response time.
  • Inbound lead contact rate.
  • Qualified-lead rate.
  • Appointment-setting rate.
  • Appointment attendance rate.
  • Missed appointment recovery rate.
  • Number of outbound calls completed.
  • Number of personalized outbound emails sent.
  • Outbound contact and response rate.
  • Number of qualified outbound appointments scheduled.
  • Number of new strategic relationships created.
  • Percentage of CRM records with complete required information.
  • Percentage of open opportunities with a scheduled next activity.
  • Number of stale or overdue opportunities.
  • Accuracy and timeliness of daily and weekly reports.
  • Required Qualifications

Exceptional spoken and written English.

  • Clear, confident, and professional telephone voice.
  • Strong listening, questioning, and note-taking skills.
  • Demonstrated success in appointment setting, inside sales, lead qualification, business development, or customer service.
  • Experience using HubSpot CRM or a comparable CRM platform.
  • Ability to learn ABG’s services, target markets, qualification criteria, and sales process.
  • Ability to work quickly without sacrificing accuracy or professionalism.
  • Strong organizational skills and consistent attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage a high volume of calls, emails, tasks, and records.
  • Comfortable speaking with senior decision-makers and business owners.
  • Ability to handle rejection and objections without losing momentum.
  • Reliable internet, telephone access, and a professional work environment if working remotely.

 

    Qualifications

    Preferred Qualifications

    • Experience managing HubSpot contacts, companies, deals, tasks, lists, workflows, sequences, and reports.
    • Experience in architecture, engineering, construction, commercial real estate, professional services, or a related industry.
    • Experience with business-to-business cold calling and email outreach.
    • Familiarity with calendar scheduling, email platforms, contact databases, and list-building tools.
    • Experience qualifying projects involving architecture, engineering, permitting, construction, development, or property improvements.

    Personal Characteristics

    • Urgent and highly responsive.
    • Persistent without being pushy.
    • Organized and process-oriented.
    • Competitive and motivated by measurable results.
    • Comfortable being held accountable to activity and conversion targets.
    • Professional under pressure.
    • Coachable and receptive to call reviews and feedback.
    • Proactive in identifying problems and recommending improvements.
    • Consistent, dependable, and disciplined.
    • Focused on creating an excellent first impression of ABG.

    What Success Looks Like

    • Prospective clients are contacted while their interest is at its highest.
    • Every lead receives fast, professional, and persistent follow-up.
    • Qualified prospects are consistently converted into scheduled appointments.
    • ABG’s HubSpot pipeline is accurate, current, and easy for leadership to manage.
    • No viable opportunity is lost because of slow response, poor communication, or missing follow-up.
    • Outbound campaigns create measurable new relationships and qualified opportunities in ABG’s target markets.
    • ABG’s leadership receives reliable reporting and has complete visibility into every active prospect and next action.

    Candidate Evaluation

    • Final candidates may be asked to complete:
    • A mock inbound lead-response call.
    • A cold-call role-play.
    • A written follow-up email exercise.
    • A HubSpot data-entry and pipeline-management exercise.
    • A spoken-English and communication assessment.

    Additional Information

    What We Offer:

    • ·         Supportive and collaborative team environment that values innovation and creativity.
    • ·         Opportunities for professional growth and skill development.
    • ·         The chance to contribute to exciting and impactful architectural projects.
